title: Unit-normalized adjunction for pro-etale module inverse image
statement: Let $f:Z\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and let $f^*$ and $f_*$ be the module inverse image and direct image with inverse-image coefficients of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], on the module sheaf categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define the canonical adjunction $f^*\dashv f_*$ to be the unique adjunction whose unit on every module $M$, site object $V\to X$ and section $s\in M(V)$ is the actual inverse-image unit section $f^{-1}s\in(f^*M)(Z\times_XV)$ [def-sfb-proetale-inverse-image-unit-section]. Here the actual section map is the unit of the sheafified module pullback on the compatible small model, transported back by the sectionwise model equivalences. This fixes the entire adjunction, including its counit, rather than choosing an arbitrary adjunction between the functors. The notation does not require $f$ to be closed, and imposes no finiteness or flatness assumption on $R$ or $M$.
